description: Sometimes, users want to have the ability to add, delete or edit existing data behind a visualization and instantly see how those changes are reflected in the Viz. Infotopics developed the ultimate solution for these challenges and many other use cases: WriteBackExtreme. Collaborate, forecast, run surveys, and much more, all safe and secure under the governance of Power BI! WriteBackExtreme is available as SaaS, Cloud and on-premises solution. 1 Month Free trial: Request a free trial and be up and running in minutes here. Your trial will be a private cloud environment for you to explore the product including example use cases. Get Started: Learn more about WriteBackExtreme here. Learn how to quickly set it up with our Product Guide. Download the demo workbook with examples and instructions from the store page. MySQL password: demodemo WriteBackExtreme has four modules: 1) Add Data When you want to add a forecast & budgeting workflow or play a What-If scenario, the WriteBackExtreme extension allows you to add or change data that is connected to the visualizations present in your dashboard. Data is connected on an aggregated level. By adding and writing back adjusted forecasts, the effect of changes is visible in the visualization almost instantly. This is the power of Add Data!
